verdict.rationale: MotherDuck exposes a documented public API surface via SDKs for multiple languages, a Postgres-compatible endpoint, a Wasm client, and a confirmed OpenAPI spec (probe-3), plus a remote/local MCP server that lets AI agents execute read/write SQL, explore schemas, and even write via the new query_rw tool. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API stability/versioning, and explicit rate-limit or auth-scheme documentation beyond secrets management.
